title: Associative data

exercises.title: Create Map
exercises.description: Create a map ages with keys "Alice" (25), "Bob" (30). Print the map.
hints: `const char *keys[] = {"Alice", "Bob"}; int vals[] = {25, 30};` — keep index alignment.
`print_str_int_map(keys, vals, 2); putchar('\n');` as in the starter.

exercises.title: Map Lookup
exercises.description: Create map scores = parallel key/value arrays{"Math": 95, "Physics": 88}. Look up "Math" and print the score.
hints: Define parallel arrays for `Math`/`Physics` and call `map_get_str_int(..., "Math", &found)`.

exercises.title: Add to Map
exercises.description: Create empty map names = empty parallel key/value arrays. Add entries: "1" -> "One", "2" -> "Two". Print map.

exercises.title: Delete from Map
exercises.description: Create map data = parallel key/value arrays{"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3}. Delete "b", then print the map.
hints: Model deletion by listing only remaining keys: `{"a", "c"}` with `{1, 3}`.

exercises.title: Check Key Existence
exercises.description: Create map inventory = parallel key/value arrays{"apples": 5, "oranges": 3}. Check if "bananas" exists and print exists or not found.

exercises.title: Map Length
exercises.description: Create map counts = parallel key/value arrays{"one": 1, "two": 2, "three": 3}. Print the number of entries using len().
hints: `const char *keys[] = {"one", "two", "three"};` — print `3` or `sizeof keys / sizeof keys[0]`.

exercises.title: Iterate Map
exercises.description: Create map grades = parallel key/value arrays{"A": 90, "B": 80, "C": 70}. Print each key-value pair.
hints: Parallel `keys[]` / `vals[]` with three grades; loop `for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)`.
